messages:
maria: Heads-up - the hot sauce shelf is out of control again 😅 Someone left an open bottle of ghost pepper on the middle shelf and now everything smells like regret. Can we do a quick tidy + rules?
jake: omg guilty 🙋‍♂️ I’ll own it. sorry y'all.
priya: Proposal: label by heat level and keep a small tray for 'extra-drippy' sauces. also: lids must be screwed on.
caleb: love the tray idea. can we add a tiny sign: 'Do not reheat lunch with ghost pepper' ☠️
emily: also can we please get a new set of spill-proof lids for the condiment caddy? those silicone ones work great.
maria: @jake, thanks - if you want to toss the open bottle (it’s basically empty) I’ll pick up replacements on my grocery run later.
jake: throwing it now. just FYI i keep two favorites: sriracha and a mystery green bottle labeled 'caleb special' that is terrifying.
priya: 😂 the "caleb special" is actually fermented mango + jalapeno from the last offsite. celestial pain.
caleb: guilty again. that one is for brave hearts only.
kitchen-bot: Reminder: Kitchen tidy-up scheduled at 5pm today. If you added sauce to the communal shelf please label and use the tray.
maria: OK team - short poll: What should I pick up? react with the emoji for your vote.
- :sriracha: sriracha (safe)
- :hot_pepper: medium hot blend
- :fire: something for brave hearts (caleb special?)
- :green_apple: spill-proof silicone lids

jake: Voted :sriracha: - we need at least one safe sauce for team lunches.
priya: :green_apple: lids please. messy lunches are my trauma.
caleb: :fire: for the brave. someone has to keep tradition alive.
emily: :green_apple: +1 on the lids. also can we add a small labeled shelf for personal bottles?
maria: Great. Plan: i'll get 1 sriracha, 1 medium blend, and a pack of silicone lids. anyone want to add to the list?
jake: maybe a tiny bottle of lime juice? goes with tacos.
priya: add a tiny bottle of soy sauce? many uses.
maria: adding both. Estimated run: leaving at 4:20pm, back by 5:05pm. If anyone wants me to grab something drop a reply before 4:05.
caleb: If you pass the corner store, could you grab 2 x those mini sample hot sauces? we can make a 'taste test' board next week.
emily: yes please taste test. will bring napkins.
kitchen-bot: Note: Please wipe down shelves after use. Food safety reminder from facilities.
maria: Thanks! I’ll also put a laminated tiny sign: 'Hot sauce shelf: label your bottle / screw the lid / tray only'.
jake: 👍
priya: thank you! truly will save many shirts and sinuses.
caleb: Respect for the laminated sign. Long live the tray.
emily: mercy mercy, the office will breathe again.
maria: End of thread: small restock run happening. If you want something, tag me now. Otherwise i'll document the new shelf layout after cleanup.
